item.title: Jabari Wright
item.description: Jabari Wright, IPH community health navigator, brings his experience as a whole-health navigator with a focus on complete wellness and relationship development. In his role, he serves as a connector for community members, practitioners, community-based organizations and agencies to facilitate and cultivate stronger, healthier and more resilient families, neighborhoods and communities. He works out of the IPH's space at the Highlander Accelerator.
